Name: Mod Sync Check
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[b]Description[/b]

  **Mod Sync Check** stops a player from joining your multiplayer farm until their mods and mod versions match yours. No
  more broken sessions because someone forgot to update a mod or is missing one entirely.

  When a player tries to join, the host compares mod lists *before* the game lets them in. A player whose mods don't
  match never enters the world; they're told why, and if they have Mod Sync Check too, they can download the missing or
  outdated mods straight from the host and rejoin after a restart.

  It can also keep everyone on the host's mod settings for the session, so all players run the same configuration
  without anyone editing files by hand.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]

  1. Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
  2. Download this mod from the **Files** tab and unzip it into your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder.
  3. Run the game using SMAPI.

  **Every player should install it, not just the host.** By default the host blocks players who don't have Mod Sync
  Check, and a player needs it to download mods from the host or use the host's settings.

  *Optional:* install [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) to change the
  settings in-game. Otherwise, edit the `config.json` that is created in the mod's folder the first time you launch the
  game.

[b]Main features[/b]

  - **Mod and version check on join.** The host checks each joining player's mods before the game approves them.
  Mismatched players are blocked before they enter the world.
  - **Clear reasons.** A blocked player sees why on their farmhand selection screen, even without the mod. Players who
  have the mod get a dialog listing the missing and wrong-version mods, and the full list is always written to the SMAPI
  log.
  - **Download mods from the host.** If both sides have the mod, a blocked player can download what they're missing or
  have at a different version, sent directly by the host. Mods are only added or updated, never removed. Replaced
  versions are backed up to `Mods/.ModSyncCheck/backup`, and the game offers to restart afterwards.
  - **Shared settings.** While in your game, players use the host's settings for the required mods. Their own
  `config.json` files are not changed, and they get their own settings back when they leave. If the host changes a
  setting mid-game, players switch to the new one.
  - **Choose what must match.** Mark any mod as required or ignored. Common client-only mods (such as Lookup Anything,
  NPC Map Locations and UI Info Suite 2) are ignored by default, and mods that only the joining player has are always
  allowed.
  - **Per-mod settings sync.** Choose for each mod whether players use your settings or keep their own.
  - **Works when only the joining player has it.** They check the host's mod list themselves and leave if it doesn't
  match.
  - **Host controls.** Turn checking on or off while hosting, choose whether Mod Sync Check itself is required, and
  allow or disallow mod downloads.
  - **Version notice.** A joining player is told when the host is running a newer or older version of Mod Sync Check.

  [b]Good to know[/b]

  - Downloads install files sent by the host, so only accept them from hosts you trust.
  - Content packs and a few mods can't have their settings changed while the game is running, so those keep the player's
  own settings.
  - Settings are never synced for Content Patcher, Generic Mod Config Menu, Console Commands, Save Backup, TimeSpeed,
  Custom Cask Mod, Harvest With Scythe and Movement Speed.

  Requirements

  **Required**

  - Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
  - [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) 4.0.0 or later

  **Optional**

  - [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098), to edit the settings in-game instead
  of in `config.json`.

  For the full feature set (mod downloads and shared settings), both the host and the joining players need Mod Sync
  Check installed.

[b]Shout outs[/b]

  Thanks to **Pathoschild** for [SMAPI](https://smapi.io), which makes Stardew Valley modding possible, and to
  **spacechase0** for [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098).

  Thanks also to **ConcernedApe** for Stardew Valley.
